The TEM diffraction contrast analysis in Fig. 1 aligns with the previously suggested FSA2 phase transformation pathway [ 6 , 10 ]. The transformations occurring during HST and aging at 900 ◦ C 5 h followed by FC can be summarized as follows: Upon cooling from single-phase α at HST temperature to room temperature: (i) Ordering to single-phase α ′ (around 1100 ◦ C) and formation of α ′ APDs. (ii) Spinodal decomposition to α / α ′ basketweave (around 1050 ◦ C) with preferred α formation at α ′ APDBs, resulting in α ′ / α / α ′ sandwiches along them. (iii) Formation of α ″ APDs in the α ′ weave.
